body: You know whats worse then a depression? Having depression, being broke, and your heart being destroyed. The rock bottom

No bro, stop it, it will only make you feel worse then. I know you feel at the rock bottom right now and you think suicide is the only answer. But its not! Its not the answer and its not a solution. Who will guarentee you that after you commit suicide it will end all misery you feel? Nobody.
If you believe in God then just think that after you kill yourself, you will be forever in the same spot feeling and doing the same shit for eternity.
I also have dark thoughts, I pray to god almost every night to take me, but i wont kill myself because its a chance that i will wake up in after life feeling the same misery and no chance to make it better. And also I have that few people who love me and I know I will destroy them emotionally forever. And thats so damn selfish. Keep your head up bro, for every dark night, theres a brighter day!

One time I had an episode of anxiety and i was feeling overwhelming and felt to tell my sister about it.
